boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D1: a run where a post-freeze criterion change altered a verdict without an appended amendment record.
claims.text: Freezing the research design (question, sources, criteria, verdict rules) before retrieval prevents post-hoc criterion drift in verdicts.
claims.stage_basis: Freeze mechanism built and tested under Spec 002 (freeze checks, amendment records); the claim's drift-prevention efficacy over live studies is not yet exercised — checked, with that limit.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D2: an exported artifact in which two items sharing one origin increase an evidence count or weight.
claims.text: Counting evidence by origin group prevents derivative sources from inflating support for a claim.
claims.stage_basis: Scoring/verdict machinery built and tested under Spec 002 with seeded defects; checked.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D3: a seeded-defect run (e.g. swapped source, corrupted evidence) that the control suite passes as valid.
claims.text: A control suite with discriminating positive and negative controls detects defective runs that a pass-only check suite would certify.
claims.stage_basis: Controls machinery built and tested; the Phase 5 demo run is live evidence the controls bite (swap-control failure invalidated the run). Checked.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002

claims.text: An append-only hash-chained event store makes silent rewriting of a research record detectable on replay.
claims.stage_basis: Evidence/provenance machinery (hash-verified retrieval records, RT-5 caps) built and tested under Spec 002; checked.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D5: any exported citation that does not resolve to a real, retrievable record (kill criterion K1).
claims.text: Resolving every citation against its source of record before use reduces fabricated-reference incidence to zero in exported artifacts.
claims.stage_basis: Design claim only; no implementation or test evidence yet. Created.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D6: an audit scenario in which a blended score and the per-claim register lead an adjudicator to the same decision quality and speed, measured under the K3 protocol.
claims.text: A per-claim verdict taxonomy (INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE/CONTRADICTED/SUPPORTED) preserves information that a single blended study score destroys — specifically, which claims failed and why.
claims.stage_basis: Design claim only, and its falsifier F-001-D6 is comparative against a K3 protocol that does not exist — inoperable today (audit NC). Created.

boundary: Assessment at design phase; implementation evidence accrues under Spec 002
falsification_tests: F-001-D7: a smaller workflow that exercises Articles I-XII completely, or a demonstration that the U2 slice omits an article (owner decision OD-1).
claims.text: The systematic-review evidence-question workflow (U2) is the smallest workflow that exercises every constitutional article end-to-end, and is therefore the correct MVP slice.
claims.stage_basis: Accepted by the owner's OD-1 ratification recorded in DN-002. Reclassification also resolves the prior presentation tension (status 'supported' at assessor score 0.68): the lifecycle stage, not the score, now carries the state (audit NC-4).

audit_note: 2026-10-12 Tao realignment audit (DN-010 standard): lifecycle_stage + stage_basis added to every claim by reclassification only; no claim text, falsifier, or evidence was rewritten. Git history is the append-only trail for AEE bundles.
